Percussion is a diagnostic technique used by healthcare providers to assess sounds and vibrations produced by tapping on various body parts.
Different organs and tissues produce characteristic sounds when percussed, aiding in identifying abnormalities.
Proper training and practice are essential for healthcare professionals to interpret percussion findings accurately.
Percussion provides valuable insights into a patient's health and guides further diagnostic tests or treatment plans.
